en: Colorized historical street view labeled "Königsbrück. Schlossstrasse." showing a slightly curving town street lined with two‑story buildings with red tile roofs. Shops with German signage occupy the ground floors, and people in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century clothing walk or stand along the street. On the right foreground is a stone monument topped with stacked cannonballs, partly obscured by trees.
